rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day 5 Gardner 3BB blastocyst, including expanded cavity, loosely grouped ICM, and loose TE. It is detailed and plausible, though some image-specific claims (e.g., exact ICM location, subtle cell-border observations) may be somewhat over-interpreted from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, BMI, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, endometrial thickness, prior cycle history, paternal age, semen parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology, age-related aneuploidy, BMI, and endometriosis. Minor issues include some speculative quantitative adjustments and slight mixing of implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth metrics.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice and Gardner grading, including single embryo transfer and counseling on age-related aneuploidy. Some recommendations are more speculative or center-dependent (e.g., higher progesterone for endometriosis, routine DFI/MACS/TESE, growth hormone), so not fully guideline-level.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and future planning, including counseling, SET, luteal support considerations, PGT-A discussion, embryo banking, weight optimization in parallel, and contingency planning.
